title: screensaver close: kill all running screensaver processes
desc: wkappbot screensaver close finds every wkappbot-core process whose command line contains 'screensaver' and sends WM_CLOSE (or Kill if windowless). Eye will respawn screensaver when idle conditions are met again.
steps: Dispatch: Program.cs screensaver case checks restArgs[0]==close -> ScreenSaverCloseCommand(). No args -> ScreenSaverStandaloneCommand() (existing behavior unchanged).
Close logic: GetProcessesByName(wkappbot-core) -> GetProcessCommandLine -> Contains(screensaver) -> PostMessageW(WM_CLOSE) if main window exists, else p.Kill(). Reports count closed.
Eye respawn: Eye (AppBotEyeGlobalMode.cs) auto-respawns screensaver when humanIdleMs >= 10000ms. Closing via this command is equivalent to user becoming active -- Eye restarts it next idle cycle.
Use case: force-close stuck screensaver overlay, test screensaver lifecycle, or dismiss before automation that requires clean screen state.

SEE ALSO: screensaver-close-command-ref for dated bug fixes, the false-positive-is-worse-than-false-negative detection principle, and the (0,0) pixel-check snippet used in the gg session-start screen-health check.
